intro.title: About us
intro.body: Private Travel Club is a global travel and concierge company that provides high-quality and first-class services to the world's most demanding clients. The many years of experience of our passionate team and partnerships around the world enable us to fulfill any of your wishes and needs, such like:
items: Planning of exclusive and luxurious trips

gallery.title: Exclusive & Luxurious Trips
gallery.body: Discover the most extraordinary and exclusive places on earth with us. Whether it's the Indian Ocean, the Caribbean, the Emirates or Europe — we'll find the best solutions for your trip worldwide. Every journey becomes an unforgettable experience. Because you deserve it!

villas.title: Villas, Chalets, Castles, Apartments & Hotels
villas.description: A castle in Italy? A chalet in France? Or maybe you would prefer a villa in the Maldives or in Greece? Stay at the best addresses worldwide and enjoy your time!

yachts.title: Yacht Charter & Private Jets
yachts.description: Thinking about a yacht charter? Good choice! From the charter to the route and program to the daily menu — we plan it for you! You need a private jet? Whether private, group or corporate charter. And no matter for what purpose. We plan that for you too!

transfers.title: Premium Car & Helicopter Transfers
transfers.description: Train to the plane? Not for you! Get into the car, relax, lean back and enjoy all the advantages of a premium transfer, including VIP lane at the airport if you wish. Or don't feel like crowded streets? Is your destination difficult to access? Helicopter makes it possible!

concierge.title: Concierge Services
concierge.description: You love the most exclusive wines? Your best friend is getting married and you want to surprise the couple with an extraordinary gift? Or cheer on your team with friends from the VIP lounge? We fulfill (almost) all of your wishes!

whyus.title: We create added value and unique experiences
whyus.body: Our portfolio and expertise offers a complete coverage of all of your wishes and needs related to travel and concierge services.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies We Use
body: Technical cookies — essential for the website to function correctly. They cannot be disabled as the site would not work without them. Example: remembering your cookie consent choice.
Analytical cookies — help us understand how visitors interact with the website (pages visited, time on site, errors). This data is collected anonymously and used solely to improve the website.
Marketing cookies — used to show relevant content and measure the effectiveness of our communications. These are only activated if you accept cookies.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Cookies
body: Our website may use third-party services (such as Google Analytics) that set their own cookies. These are governed by the respective third party's privacy policy. We do not control third-party cookies.

sections.heading: 4. Managing Cookies
body: You can manage or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of this website.
You can also withdraw your consent by clearing your browser's local storage or cookies at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Contact
body: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at office@private-travel-club.com.

sections.heading: 1. General Provisions
body: This Privacy Policy (hereinafter – the Policy) defines how we collect, process, store and protect personal data of users (hereinafter – Users) of the website private-travel-club.com.

The website is operated by Tatiana Ebert (address: Sudetenstraße 12, 96250 Ebensfeld, Germany), hereinafter referred to as the "Company", "we", "us", also registered in Russia as sole trader IE Ebert Tatiana Nikolaevna (OGRNIP 320774600263749, INN 772972873029, registered office address: Michurinsky Prospect 9, bldg. 4, office 129, Moscow, Russia).

This Policy complies with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 'On Personal Data'. By submitting a contact form or otherwise using this website, you confirm that you have read this Policy and consent to the processing of your personal data as described herein.

sections.heading: 2. Data We Collect
body: Data you provide directly: full name and phone number submitted via the contact form; any additional information you choose to include in your message or email to us.
Data collected automatically: IP address, browser type and version, device type, pages visited, time on site, and cookie identifiers in accordance with Section 5 of this Policy.
We do not collect special categories of data (payment card details, passport numbers, health data) unless explicitly required for a specific service and consented to separately.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes of Processing
body: We process your personal data to: respond to your enquiries and provide luxury travel planning, villa and chalet rental, yacht charter, private jet charter, and concierge services; prepare and send personalised proposals and service information; improve our website and service quality; comply with applicable legal obligations.
We do not use your data for automated decision-making or profiling without your explicit consent.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
body: For EU/EEA users (GDPR): processing is based on Art. 6(1)(a) – your consent; Art. 6(1)(b) – necessity for pre-contractual measures; Art. 6(1)(c) – compliance with a legal obligation; Art. 6(1)(f) – legitimate interests of the Company.
For users in Russia (152-FZ): processing is based on your consent in accordance with Art. 9 of Federal Law No. 152-FZ, as well as on execution of a contract initiated by the data subject.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
body: Our website uses cookies — small text files stored on your device — to ensure website functionality, analyse visitor behaviour, and improve user experience. Types used: technical (essential), functional (personalisation), and analytical/marketing (effectiveness tracking).
You may manage or disable cookies at any time via your browser settings. For full details, see our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 6. Data Storage, Localisation and Protection
body: In compliance with Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ, the primary collection, recording, systematisation, accumulation, and storage of personal data of citizens of the Russian Federation are carried out using databases located within the territory of the Russian Federation.

Once legally collected in the Russian Federation, data may be transferred to the Company's European office via cross-border transfer mechanisms in strict accordance with applicable laws (GDPR and 152-FZ) for the sole purpose of processing travel requests. Technical data (IP addresses, logs) may be processed by the infrastructure provider (Vercel Inc.) in accordance with its security standards.

We implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect your data. Access is restricted to authorised personnel only. Personal data is retained for no longer than necessary to fulfil the stated purposes, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
body: Under GDPR (EU/EEA users): right of access, rectification, erasure ('right to be forgotten'), restriction of processing, data portability, objection to processing, and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA), Promenade 27, 91522 Ansbach, Germany.

Under 152-FZ (users in Russia): right to obtain information about the processing of your personal data, to request correction or deletion, to withdraw consent, and to lodge a complaint with Roskomnadzor.
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at office@private-travel-club.com. We will respond within 10 business days (30 calendar days for requests under 152-FZ).

sections.heading: 8. Final Provisions
body: This Policy applies to all Users of the website. We reserve the right to amend it at any time; the updated version will be published on this page.
